title: Theo and the Choir
author: Orsen Oyelaran
blurb: Tamsin Sandoval, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
